theorem:
inductive HeadTruthStatus where
  | match
  | mismatch
  | truthUnavailable
  | truthSourceUnavailable
  | invalidActualCount
  deriving DecidableEq

def matched : HeadTruthStatus -> Bool
  | .match => true
  | _ => false

def warningRequired : HeadTruthStatus -> Bool
  | .match => false
  | _ => true

theorem onlySealedMatchCanSetMatched (status : HeadTruthStatus) :
    matched status = true <-> status = .match := by
  cases status <;> decide

theorem everyNonMatchRequiresWarning (status : HeadTruthStatus) :
    warningRequired status = !matched status := by
  cases status <;> decide

theorem unavailableTruthCannotPromote :
    matched .truthUnavailable = false /\
    matched .truthSourceUnavailable = false /\
    matched .invalidActualCount = false := by
  decide

theorem mismatchDeltaIsExact :
    let expected : Int := 1420
    let actual : Int := 243
    actual - expected = -1177 := by
  decide

inductive SyncSourceExtension where
  | csv
  | pdf
  | html
  | htm
  | unsupported
  deriving DecidableEq

def mayOpenPriceDb : SyncSourceExtension -> Bool
  | .unsupported => false
  | _ => true

theorem unsupportedExtensionCannotOpenPriceDb :
    mayOpenPriceDb .unsupported = false := by
  decide
